_doc: Nitro Cell (defender pool; research/gadgets.md §4.3). One each; the heavy throw (Y3S4); it sticks to whatever it hits; its owner's phone sets it off; electronic. Its size is a placeholder. Its blast: 171 hp within 2 m, none past 6 m (Fandom, maybe from before Y6S3), through breakable surfaces undimmed (Fandom); it cuts soft surfaces within 1 m (ours). One bullet destroys it without a blast (Fandom).
name: Nitro Cell
